text:
Maya (AE): Hey team, Acme Security is blocking the deal — they asked for our SOC 2 report, a signed NDA, and a bridge letter while our current Type II is in process. They want everything this week if possible.
Ben (InfoSec): Thanks for flagging. Do we have an up-to-date SOC 2 Type II or only Type I on file? Also, any existing bridge-letter template? :thinking_face:
Carla (Legal): We have a mutual NDA template ready. I can send via DocuSign once we get the counterparty details. Need the signatory name and billing entity.
Dae (SolutionsEng): From a technical side they also asked for the private deployment architecture and a short control summary for data handling. I can assemble diagrams and the control matrix (storage, encryption, key management).
Maya (AE): Acme provided contact: security@acme-co.com, signatory: Jordan Lee (Dir, Procurement). They specifically said: "bridge letter to attest controls cover session between audit periods."
Ben (InfoSec): Quick update: we have a SOC 2 Type II for Redwood Hosted dated 2025-03-01 (covers platform controls) — but the Private deployment package is on a separate attestation path and is in progress. We can share the hosted SOC 2 report now. For the bridge letter: we can draft a short attestation listing current control status and expected audit completion window.
Carla (Legal): Good. I'll prepare the NDA and a short mutual agreement. Draft subject line for DocuSign: 
```
Redwood Inference - Mutual NDA for Acme (Jordan Lee)
```
Maya (AE): Acme asked if we can include a one-off bridge letter instead of waiting for the finished report — they need it for their vendor risk review.
Ben (InfoSec): We can do a bridge letter but must be careful with wording. Suggest: 1) reference the last SOC 2 Type II we can share, 2) state that an audit for Private deployment is 'in progress' with estimated completion date, 3) list compensating controls currently in place (encryption at rest/in transit, KMS integration, access reviews, incident response).
Dae (SolutionsEng): I'll create a condensed architecture diagram and export a control mapping (CSV) that maps our controls -> SIG/CAIQ sections they care about. Will also include pen-test summary (redacted) and vuln SLA.
Carla (Legal): For NDA turnaround: I can send the DocuSign today. Expect signature within 24-48h usually. For the bridge letter, Ben — can you draft the technical statement by EOD tomorrow? I'll review it and then finalize sign-off wording.
Ben (InfoSec): Yep — will draft. Plan: attach hosted SOC 2 PDF (redacted PII), include control list, and a short paragraph as bridge attestation with estimated audit completion date: 2026-05-15.
Maya (AE): Acme also asked about who signs the bridge letter (legal vs security). They prefer a CISO-level signatory. Do we have an authorized signer?
Carla (Legal): We can sign from Legal with a delegated signature block: "On behalf of Redwood Inference, by authorized representative, Legal Dept." If they insist on CISO, we'll loop in Ben for co-sign or get the CISO on the doc.
Ben (InfoSec): I can co-sign. I will ensure phrasing avoids absolute guarantees — attestation of current controls and timeline only.
Acme Security Bot: Automated request received: please provide SOC 2 report link and completed vendor questionnaire (SIG).
Maya (AE): I'll upload the hosted SOC 2 redacted PDF to the secure file share and send the link to acme-security@acme-co.com after NDA is signed. Also pinging them to prioritize the SIG sections about encryption and key management.
Dae (SolutionsEng): Action items for me: 1) architecture diagram + control mapping (SIG->Controls) 2) redacted pen-test summary 3) sample deployment config (no secrets). ETA 3 business days.
Carla (Legal): Action items for me: 1) send NDA today via DocuSign 2) review bridge letter wording once Ben drafts.
Ben (InfoSec): Action items: 1) draft bridge-letter attestation EOD tomorrow 2) prepare SOC 2 redacted PDF link 3) provide short risk summary (1 page).
Maya (AE): I'll keep Acme updated and push for a quick signature so we can release docs. Thanks all — please @mention if anything slips. :pray: 
Ben (InfoSec): One more note — include the standard non-disclosure clause for SOC 2 artifacts (not to be redistributed). I'll add that language for the shared link.
Carla (Legal): Good call. I'll add a DocuSign checkbox for "I agree to confidentiality terms for audit artifacts."
Maya (AE): Perfect. I'll follow up with Acme once NDA is sent. If they need an exec call, I'll schedule with Jordan + Ben/Carla.
Dae (SolutionsEng): Marking the ticket in our queue: POC-2456 — will attach artifacts & ping when ready.
Maya (AE): Closing loop: target to have NDA signed and SOC 2 link shared within 48 hours, bridge letter draft in 72 hours. I'll update the CRM and incident thread.
Carla (Legal): Sounds good. 
Maya (AE): Thanks team! :thumbsup:
